gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-lao: Technical and geometric, Ozone draws every stem and crossbar with one constant pen width, while Noto Serif Lao tilts a soft nib across its tall lowercase. Ozone is best at blunt, wire-like display lines, but the text serif is where gentle weight shifts do their work.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-makasar: Ozone sets stems and crossbars to a single thickness, so its wide round curves look almost machined. Noto Serif Makasar then brings a towering lowercase and thin strokes only slightly slimmer than its stems, giving the pair a sturdy, editorial footing.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-malayalam: Ozone's w has no thick or thin strokes at all, just one smooth line bent into shape. Make it small and that bare wire look thins out, while Noto Serif Malayalam stays comfortable.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-np-hmong: Noto Serif NP Hmong reads literary and refined, with a faint swell in every curve. Ozone is best at flat, unpinched display lines, whereas the serif body is built for that slight charcoal-like pressure shadow.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-old-uyghu: Ozone has no thick-thin modulation anywhere, just clean geometric lines with wide-set curve ends. Noto Serif Old Uyghur gives the line its depth, since its blown-glass lowercase shifts weight only slightly and quietly.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-oriya: Monoline construction defines Ozone, with capitals that hardly rise above the lowercase and curves that stay wide. Noto Serif Oriya brings dignity through hairlines that are neither wispy nor heavy.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-ottoman-s: Ozone's strokes look like bent copper pipe. Beside Noto Serif Ottoman Siyaq, whose thin strokes barely lighten its thick ones, the pair's strongest quality is a shared restraint in stroke contrast.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-sinhala: Noto Serif Sinhala stacks a tall band of letters under short stalks, with stroke weights that differ just enough to feel alive. Beside Ozone's flat, unvaried lines, a longer passage would read refined and bookish.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-telugu: Noto Serif Telugu reads traditional and refined, with a gentle thick to thin shift and lowercase that nearly touches the capitals. Ozone, drawn like thread stitched along a path, hands over to a text serif whose stems are only a shade heavier than their arms.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-thai: Noto Serif Thai has dominant bodies and barely visible ascenders. Ozone's wire-bent headings sit above that lightly shaded texture, so the page moves from technical outlines to a mellow, authoritative classic serif.
